claims.subject: Panco Poultry Ltd.
claims.finding: The Province bought all issued common and preferred shares in February 1975 for CAD 4,800,000; B.C. Testing Farms, Pacific Hatching and Western Feeds are described as wholly owned subsidiaries.

For the final acquisition event, use the companion identity review’s more precise direct-accounts evidence: 17 February 1975, in the 1978/79 Public Accounts, F215.
claims.verification_scope: What the specified Statistics Canada source reports; legal continuity and currentness require corroboration.

claims.subject: Roster reliability and hierarchy
claims.finding: Verified headings do not guarantee current legal existence or accurate parentage of every row. The 1984 appendix prints Surrey Farm Products Investments Ltd., Western Feed Co. Ltd. and Pacific Hatchery Ltd. as inactive level 01 entities. The Duke Point rows follow Ocean Falls and First Capital across the page break. British Columbia Cellulose Company also remains listed in the roster headed 31 December 1986.
claims.action: Preserve as-printed data and the code legend. Resolve anomalous edges using company annual accounts, registry records and legal instruments. Prefer direct legal or audited evidence in conflicts. For the Cellulose example, consult companion ownership review claim OWN-C09 and sources OWN-S05–OWN-S07; this review verifies the roster row, not those legal dates.
claims.verification_scope: What the specified Statistics Canada source reports; legal continuity and currentness require corroboration.

cross_review_note.reported_conflict: The companion review reports a repeal effective 31 March 1986 and an accounts dissolution date of 1 April 1986, both earlier than the roster heading. It preserves the unresolved one-day legal boundary.
cross_review_note.verification_scope: Legal and accounts dates are attributed to the separate ownership review; independently verified here only that the 31 December 1986 roster still includes British Columbia Cellulose Company.
